I will not buy chemical fertilizer for this plot because one bag is too much for only 0.10 hectares and I do not have the cash to waste on what I cannot fully use. I will carry two wheelbarrows of manure from my compound and spread it before planting, and I will use the millet seed I kept from last season since it still germinates well. My wife and children will help me with the weeding, bird scaring, and harvest on this small piece, so I will not hire any workers.
